description: Calculate an itemized price estimate for what the user actually wants — bags or pounds of wash & fold plus dry-cleaning garments named in plain words (e.g. '2-piece suit', 'dress shirt', 'winter coat'). Answers 'how much will it cost' before scheduling. Returns line items, subtotal, and total in cents and USD (no hidden fees; orders under the $39.99 minimum are billed at the minimum). Note: the actual charge is calculated at intake when bags are weighed, but this estimate is accurate to within ~10% for typical orders. These are residential prices — hotel guest orders are priced differently (see get_pricing hotelGuestRates).

dryCleaningItems.description: Dry-cleaning garments. Name each one in plain words; it is matched to Fold's garment list: Dress shirt, Blouse, Polo shirt, T-shirt, Tank top / cami, Scarf, Tie, Pants / slacks, Jeans, Skirt, Shorts, Sweater, Cardigan, Vest, Light jacket, Dress, Jumpsuit / romper, Blazer, Sport coat, Light coat / trench, Suit jacket (1 piece), 2-piece suit, 3-piece suit, Gown / formal dress, Tuxedo, Winter coat / parka, Leather jacket (light). Unrecognized names are returned in unmatchedItems instead of being priced.

washFoldBags.description: Number of W&F bags. Each bag holds ~22 lb. Set to 0 if no W&F.

washFoldPounds.description: Alternative to washFoldBags — total pounds for à-la-carte PAYG W&F pricing ($2.65/lb). Use one or the other, not both.

zipCode.description: Optional ZIP for market-specific pricing (defaults to LA rates if omitted).

name: get_estimate
title: Get estimate
